findings.detail: No running pod in kubemap-demo has all of app.kubernetes.io/name=catalog-api. Pods here have app.kubernetes.io/name=api,batch-worker,catalog,checkout,oom, not catalog-api (a typo? "catalog-api" vs "catalog").
findings.fix: Fix the Service's selector, or the labels in the workload's pod template, so they agree.
findings.command: kubectl -n kubemap-demo get pods -l app.kubernetes.io/name=catalog-api; kubectl -n kubemap-demo get pods --show-labels
